doc.title: Jackie McLean — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

chapter: Harlem youth, Monk and Bird, and Greensboro
title: His first record, with Charlie Singleton's rhythm-and-blues band
summary: McLean played baritone on Camel Walkin' for Singleton in New York around 1947-48, before Dig.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: I understand that although people say that Dig was the first thing you recorded, you actually did something while you were there. Is that with the Charlie Singleton, Camel Walkin’?

No, that was another one. That was the first record that I ever made, period. That was a rhythm-and-blues thing with Charlie Singleton’s band. I wasn’t – didn’t play any solos on it. I played baritone on that.
In New York Street, at 125th Street.
This is prior to you going to – obviously, if it was before Dig.
